description: This file defines the Coocook::Controller::Email::ChangeEmail class, which manages email change workflows within a web application, including preparing data for current email and new email verification pages.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Email::ChangeEmail
classes.description: Controller class handling email change processes, extending Coocook::Controller, with methods to prepare email verification data.

methods.name: to_current_email
methods.description: Prepares data for the current email verification page, including email address and account settings URL.

methods.name: to_new_email
methods.description: Prepares data for the new email verification page, including verification URL with token.
